display.purpose: Hero headlines and every section h2/h3. Never used for body copy or UI chrome.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, card descriptions, helper text, and all UI chrome.

label.purpose: Section kickers and form field labels: 0.7rem, 0.28em tracking, uppercase. Already at saturation across the site — don't add to new sections by default.

shadows.name: opened-state-glow
shadows.purpose: Signals an expanded/active inventory card. Not used as ambient depth anywhere else.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: Hero and section entrance: translateY(14px) to 0, opacity 0 to 1.

motion.name: image-hover-scale
motion.purpose: Slow scale-to-105% on card/thumbnail images on hover or open state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid pill CTA — the only primary action style on the site.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; background: #00081D; color: #F7FBFD; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; border: none; transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0079BA; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined pill CTA for secondary/lower-commitment actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: #00081D; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; transition: all 0.25s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: currentColor; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover span { color: #ECF7FC; }

components.name: Inventory Card
components.description: Yacht/car listing row — border-only at rest, elevated shadow when expanded.
components.html:
Azimut 68

Full-crew sport yacht, half-day to overnight.
components.css: .ds-inv-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #D6E0E7; background: #FFFFFF; transition: all 0.5s ease; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; } .ds-inv-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,8,29,0.2); } .ds-inv-thumb { background: #00081D; height: 140px; } .ds-inv-meta { padding: 20px 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-inv-meta h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #00081D; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-inv-meta p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #576574; margin: 0; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Contact form text input — rounded-lg, ink border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #576574; } .ds-field input { display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #DEE6EC; background: #ECF7FC; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #031222; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #00081D; }

components.name: Filter Pill Field
components.description: Inventory search/filter input — pill-shaped, accent-blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-filter-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #D6E0E7; background: #ECF7FC; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #00081D; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-filter-input::placeholder { color: #576574; } .ds-filter-input:focus { border-color: #0079BA; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,121,186,0.16); }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section kicker / form label. Already saturated across the site — see Eyebrow-At-Capacity rule.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #576574; margin: 0; }

components.name: Sticky Mobile CTA
components.description: Fixed bottom bar on mobile carrying the single primary CTA, mounted by PageShell on every route.
components.css: .ds-sticky-cta { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-top: 1px solid #D6E0E7; background: rgba(236,247,252,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem calc(0.75rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }

narrative.overview:
Avori Group's system reads as a members-only concierge ledger, not a booking marketplace: deep navy ink, a pale blue-white paper ground, and a single restrained sky-blue accent that appears only where a decision is being asked for. Cormorant Garamond display type gives every headline an editorial, slightly formal weight; Inter carries all working text so the system never feels precious about itself. The overall density is generous because the audience is deciding on a five-figure weekend, not scanning a feature list.

This system explicitly rejects gaudy or ostentatious luxury signaling: heavy gilt ornamentation, glitter, superlative-stacked copy, and gold-and-black luxury-template clichés. Confidence here is shown through specificity and restraint, not decoration. It also rejects marketplace patterns in favor of a curated, editorial presentation of a small, vetted roster.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy ink is the true primary color, despite the --primary variable pointing elsewhere
One sky-blue accent, used sparingly for a single decision point per screen
Gold and sand tokens exist but are unwired — reserved, not decorative filler
Pill-shaped buttons only — no square or soft-radius buttons anywhere
Restrained motion: one rise entrance keyframe, slow ease-out image scale, no choreography

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Primary Rule
rules.body: New components should reach for ink for solid fills and strong text, treating --primary as legacy/shadcn-primitive territory only.

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Only one saturated hue (accent blue) is live at any time; gold, if activated, shares rather than stacks onto that budget.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Feeling Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond is reserved for headings that should land emotionally; it never appears in body copy, labels, or UI chrome.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-At-Capacity Rule
rules.body: The eyebrow label already sits above nearly every section; don't add more of them to new sections.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Default state for any new card or panel is a hairline border on card background; shadow is reserved for the single expanded/active signal.

dos: Do use ink for solid fills, strong text, and icon roundels
Do keep buttons as full pills at 3rem height using .btn-primary / .btn-ghost
Do default new cards/panels to a hairline border on card background
Do reserve accent-blue for one decision point per view
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for reveal and hover-scale transitions
Do preserve or strengthen the text-shadow on hero copy over dark imagery
donts: Don't use raw Tailwind palette colors like bg-slate-900 for dark surfaces — use ink
Don't add another eyebrow kicker to a new section by default
Don't introduce gold or sand as ambient decoration
Don't use square or soft-radius buttons
Don't add marketplace UI like star ratings or dense filter sidebars
Don't use heavy gilt ornamentation, glitter, or superlative-stacked copy
